newsitem.title: TURKEY: Turkey says 85 Kurdish rebels killed in clashes.
newsitem.headline: Turkey says 85 Kurdish rebels killed in clashes.

text.p: Turkish troops have killed 85 Kurdish rebels in clashes over the last four days, security officials said on Friday.

The emergency rule governor's office said in a statement that 62 guerrillas from the separatist Kurdistan Workers Party (PKK) were killed in an operation which began on Thursday in Hakkari province near Turkey's border with Iraq.
One soldier was killed in the clashes along the border, the statement said. It said a further 23 PKK rebels were killed in other provinces in the east and southeast of the country.
It was not clear whether the fighting in Hakkari had spilled over into northern Iraq, but Turkey has said in the past that it occasionally pursues rebels across the border.
The latest clashes follow the launching of a major operation involving up to 40,000 troops against the rebels in Tunceli province at the start of the week.
More than 21,000 people have died in the 12-year-old fight between the Turkish security forces and the PKK.
